title: Scenario 10: the desk that will not link
task: Desks 7 and 8 were cabled last week. Desk 8 works; desk 7 never links. Test the cable from the switch, then shut 1/1/7 and describe it with what you found (the pair and the distance) so the cabling contractor knows where to dig.
hints: `show interface 1/1/7`: waiting for link, and nothing else to go on.
`diag cable-diagnostic test 1/1/7` asks before it runs: the test drops the link while it runs. Then `diag cable-diagnostic show 1/1/7`.
Open on one pair at a distance means a break or an unterminated pair that far out. 1000BASE-T needs all four pairs.
The TDR here is the sandbox faking the hardware: the Switch Simulator has no PHY and refuses the command. The command and its output layout are from HPE's diagnostics guide (10.11 and later).
